kebab_example: aliyun linkedmall init-apply-refund --biz-id LMALL20000000001 --biz-uid 182000000062 --sub-lm-order-id 5100000013 --biz-claim-type 1 --goods-status 6 --use-anonymous-tb-account true --third-party-user-id example-string --account-type ANONY --api-version 2018-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InitApplyRefund

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the business, provided by Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh: 业务的唯一标识号，由阿里云提供
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The value must be the same as that of thirdPartyUserId
parameters.name: biz_uid

parameters.help_en: The sub-order ID for the refund request. You can obtain this value from the order details query operation
parameters.help_zh: 发起退款的⼦订单号，可在查询订单详情接⼝中获取
parameters.name: sub_lm_order_id

parameters.help_en:
The refund type. Valid values:
1: refund only
3: return and refund
parameters.help_zh: 退款类型：1 仅退款，3 退货退款
parameters.name: biz_claim_type

parameters.help_en:
The goods status. Valid values:
4: not shipped
6: shipped
1: not received
2: received
3: returned
5: seller confirmed receipt
parameters.help_zh: 货物状态：4: 未发货, 6: 已发货, 1: 未收到货, 2: 已收到货, 3:已寄回, 5: 卖家确认收货
parameters.name: goods_status

parameters.help_en: The user ID on the customer side
parameters.name: third_party_user_id

parameters.help_en: The account type. Fixed value: ANONY
parameters.name: account_type
